description: Run lightweight compatibility search across companies, people, lists, and tasks for ChatGPT MCP. Never support complex filters, batch queries, or return rich record payloads (use search_records* tools). Requires query string (min 1 char); optional type filter; limit up to 25 results per call. When you need pagination or attribute filtering, switch to search_records or search_records_advanced.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

name: search
